argument_uniqueness_tracing.bizgas_agreement_id: b4b3219d-a5a0-4b5d-a6b8-5fa6dc706fd1. Basis: docstring 'the commercial gas agreement number of the site whose swing shortfall line is corrected, as shown on the agreement record returned by the commercial gas agreement lookup'; one gas agreement for Torres Family Kitchens LLC. Uniqueness: single agreement.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.source_billing_id: 7d2b330e-a110-41db-abad-944066c18c9f. Basis: shortfall rebill rule 'A swing shortfall correction is worked on the agreement's most recently posted swing_shortfall_charge line' and base 'tied to that line through source_billing_id'; the June 2026 shortfall line (posted 2026-07-23) is the latest. Uniqueness: the 2024 and 2025 shortfall lines are older and past the twelve-month lookback.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.billing_period_start: 2026-06-21. Basis: docstring 'the first day of the billing cycle of the corrected line ... exactly as it appears on that line'; the June 2026 shortfall line carries 2026-06-21. Uniqueness: copied from the one corrected line.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.rebill_amount_usd: 41.02. Factors: billed lower end 1200 + 560 = 1760; monthly contract volume round(26400/12) = 2200; 36 energy lines and two loyalty credits on file -> lowered by 10% of 2200 = 220 -> 1540; the cycle runs 2026-06-21..2026-07-17 = 27 days < 28 -> round(1540 x 27 / 30) = 1386; 36 energy lines -> deadband 100 -> shortfall 1386 - 1200 - 100 = 86 therms; electricity agreement on the premise active and its energy charges of the last twelve months 20148.00 >= 15000 -> 0.0300 per therm -> 2.58; over-billed 33.60 - 2.58 = 31.02; one rebill credit in 24 months -> service recovery credit 10.00; total 41.02.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.offered_variant_name: Beacon Ridge Commercial Gas Fixed 12. Basis: lapsed-renewal rule 'the agreement takes the offered plan'; both 2026 notices offer Beacon Ridge Commercial Gas Fixed 12 and the customer asks for the 12-month fixed plan. argument_uniqueness_tracing.term_months: 12. Basis: 'the agreement takes the offered plan and its term_months'; Fixed 12 carries term_months 12. Uniqueness: fixed by the plan.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.contract_rate_usd_therm: 0.6720. Factors: the final options notice (2026-09-02) was 18 days before the 2026-09-20 end (< 30) and the initial notice (2026-07-01) was 81 days before it (inside 60..90) -> offer price = initial notice price 0.6840; 12 days since plan_change_date 2026-09-21 (>= 11) -> +0.0150; electricity agreement on the premise active with term_months 24 (>= 24) -> -0.0120; two rebill credits in the last 24 months after the shortfall rebill (2025-05-28 and today) -> -0.0100; 23500 therms billed on energy lines of the last twelve months (15000..29999) -> -0.0050; 0.6840 + 0.0150 - 0.0120 - 0.0100 - 0.0050 = 0.6720.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.contract_annual_therms: 25400. Basis: base bizgas_renewal 'contract_annual_therms is reset to the site's annual_therm_usage on the acceptance date'; find_premises returns 25400. Uniqueness: one value.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.new_contract_end_date: 2027-10-02. Basis: base 'after a rollover it starts on the acceptance date' (2026-10-03) and bizgas_enrollment_processing 'the day before the same calendar day term_months calendar months after' the start: 2027-10-03 minus one day. Uniqueness: deterministic.

user_scenario: You are Miguel Torres, who runs Torres Family Kitchens LLC, a family restaurant at 1932 W Cermak Rd in Chicago. You call Beacon Ridge Energy on a Saturday morning before the lunch rush; you are warm and talkative but a bit annoyed with yourself. Your gas contract for the restaurant ended on September 20 and, because you never sent anything back, the account was moved onto the monthly index plan; you saw that change on the account. You want to get back on a 12-month fixed price, the same kind of plan you have had every year, and you want to do it today. You got renewal letters over the summer but you do not remember the prices in them; you leave that to the agent. Only when the agent asks, you give the restaurant's phone number 7735550174, and for identity you add the last four digits of the company EIN, 4682. You do not know your customer number or when the account was opened. If asked about the site, it is the restaurant at 1932 W Cermak Rd, the only gas site you have with Beacon Ridge, and if asked you confirm Beacon Ridge also supplies the restaurant's electricity. You do not know how any of these figures are worked out, and you never suggest a price yourself. If the agent points out a charge on the gas account that was billed too high and needs correcting, he asks them to correct it and lets them do it. You are the owner and authorized person, and you want to accept the renewal yourself: when the agent tells you it is ready and hands the acceptance to you, you accept it with exactly the details the agent reads out, and repeat back what the confirmation shows if asked. If the agent quotes a plan other than the 12-month fixed one, you say that is not the plan from the letters and ask them to look again. Once the agent tells you the renewal is in place, you say thanks and hang up to get back to the kitchen; you ask for nothing else.
design_rationale:
WORKLOG task 1 (commercial_gas_care, category bizgas).
[Step 0 draw] draw_counts.py --task 1 -> {"prerequisite_problems": 1, "problems": 2, "factor_counts": [5, 5]}. Root bizgas_ext_lapsed_renewal_price takes 5 factors, prerequisite bizgas_ext_swing_shortfall_rebill takes 5.
[Scope snapshot] Occupied by task 0: bizgas_ext_swing_excess_rebill + post_bizgas_swing_rebill_d99acf60 (swing excess lines) and bizgas_ext_renewal_loyalty_credit + accept_bizgas_renewal_offer_c0a82e44 (renewal accepted on or before contract_end_date, with its loyalty credit). Claimed here, disjoint: bizgas_ext_swing_shortfall_rebill + post_bizgas_shortfall_rebill_b4d87cc1 (swing shortfall lines) and bizgas_ext_lapsed_renewal_price + accept_bizgas_lapsed_renewal_f259b0f9 (renewal accepted after rollover within the grace period; no loyalty credit; price re-worked). Headroom after this task: none needed (M = 2); every extended policy is claimed exactly once.
[Why a good test] Surface ask: 'get me back on a 12-month fixed price' after the rollover. The scored quantity is the renewed price per therm, never named by the customer and not the printed offer: its policy says it is not fixed until every swing shortfall line billed above the shortfall rules carries its rebill credit. The agent must find the June 2026 shortfall line (7d2b330e-a110-41db-abad-944066c18c9f) billed 33.60 against 2.58 allowed, work the 5-factor shortfall correction (seasoned-site lower end, 27-day cycle fit, deadband, bundled shortfall rate read from the electricity ledger, service recovery credit), post it, then re-count the rebill credits and price the renewal from the notices (the late final options notice makes the properly-given July offer govern), the days since rollover, the electricity agreement's term, the rebill history and the billed volume.
[Problem-tree card] Root bizgas_ext_lapsed_renewal_price -> bizgas_ext_swing_shortfall_rebill, value_input, gate rebills_last_24m, form state, negated direction. Sentence: 'The renewed price is not fixed until the agreement's most recently posted swing shortfall line, when its billed amount is above the correct shortfall amount and its correction lookback has not ended, carries its own rebill credit.' Four-point test: connective 'not until'; waited-on side a record-visible state (a rebill credit standing against the most recently posted shortfall line when it is above the correct shortfall amount and inside its lookback); no tool/id/code token; strength 'not until', scope exactly that one line. The charter carries both directions: task 0's sentence is affirmative ('fixed only after'), this one negated, each as the desk would phrase it for its result. Only one write of the difficulty puts a rebill credit on a swing shortfall line: the shortfall rebill. Derivation: sentence + ledger (latest shortfall line 7d2b330e-a110-41db-abad-944066c18c9f, no rebill credit pointing at it) + the shortfall rebill rule -> post the shortfall rebill on 7d2b330e-a110-41db-abad-944066c18c9f. Opening falsity: initial_state.bizgas_billing.7d2b330e-a110-41db-abad-944066c18c9f.amount_usd = 33.6, no rebill_credit with that source. Order: rebill (step 9) before acceptance (step 11). Deletion sensitivity: without the rebill the price is 0.6770 instead of 0.6720 and the ledger lacks the -41.02 line. Persona never mentions the shortfall or a correction; both tools write unconditionally.
[Base-invariant card] Step 9: bizgas_dispute_lookback (posted 2026-07-23, ends 2027-07-23 inclusive) and bizgas_one_correction_per_line (no rebill points at 7d2b330e-a110-41db-abad-944066c18c9f); 41.02 is within the 250.00 agent limit. Step 11: bizgas_renewal_active (status active after rollover) and bizgas_post_expiry_grace (anchor plan_change_date 2026-09-21, day one 2026-09-22, closes end of 2026-10-06; frozen 2026-10-03 inside). Inherited unchanged: offered plan and term from the notices, contract_annual_therms = premise annual_therm_usage (25400), new term starts on the acceptance date (2026-10-03), end 2027-10-02.
